## Project Conventions
- Use PascalCase for public members, camelCase for private fields
- Use hungarian notation for private fields (e.g., `_myField`)
- Use `I` prefix for interfaces (e.g., `IService`)
- Use `Async` suffix for asynchronous methods (e.g., `GetDataAsync`)
- All public methods require XML doc comments
- Use async/await for I/O operations
- Target .NET 10 with nullable reference types enabled
